title: Habitat Patch
description: PROPOSED HabitatPatch schema. It declares only the two optional connectivity reference arrays that tools/validators/domains/habitat/validate_habitat_patch.py already enforces; that validator additionally requires sorted order and denies lifecycle-private prefixes. Identity, geometry, source-role, evidence, sensitivity, and release fields remain for the owning domain steward to define (see contracts/domains/habitat/habitat_patch.md), so other members stay open.

connectivity_edge_refs.description: Optional references to ConnectivityEdge objects. References are not resolved.

corridor_refs.description: Optional references to Corridor objects. References are not resolved.
